goal: Make negated configuration options like -nofoo and -foo=0 behave predictably or fail cleanly
Prevent node crashes, accidental connections, and unexpected behavior from negated path and string options
agreement: Substantive support across multiple reviews with no open objections
Strong support for fixing options that crashed the node, failed startup, or did the opposite of stated (ryanofsky)
Strong support for cleaning up surprising negation behavior while preserving meaningful zero values (l0rinc)
Open suggestions to disallow -nodbcache, fix Qt signer display, and improve test coverage (l0rinc)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it fixes crashes, misconfigurations, and inverted behaviors caused by negated startup options
Resolves bugs where negating options set literal 0 values for passwords, paths, and commands
